description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). KE(k primary key: keys 3, 1, 2) and KF(k non-unique index: keys 2, 1, 3, 1), as in r-q5-join-order/inner-index (both indexed: the smaller KE drives the snapshot). Each of SELECT t, u FROM KE INNER JOIN KF ON KE.k = KF.k; SELECT t, u FROM KF INNER JOIN KE ON KE.k = KF.k opened as a dynaset and then as a snapshot, all rows read. Asks whether a join's dynaset comes in its snapshot's order or in another (a key order of either table).
